patterns.name: Motion responds to interaction frequency
patterns.mechanism: Use motion when it explains a state or spatial relationship; keep repeated navigation and keyboard actions immediate and interruptible. Reduced motion retains state feedback without movement.
bad_for: decorative animation on every repeated action

sources.evidence: author-published mechanism; project application is inference, not browser measurement

patterns.name: Feedback stays attached to its trigger
patterns.mechanism: Acknowledge actions immediately. If an optional surface animates, anchor its origin to the trigger and use restrained travel. Feedback remains visible when movement is disabled.

sources.evidence: author-published mechanism; project application is inference, not browser measurement

patterns.name: Reserve layout before animating presentation
patterns.mechanism: Place essential content and stable geometry in the document first. Prefer optional transform/opacity animation and profile actual rendering work; introduce layer promotion only after observing a concrete issue.

sources.evidence: author-published mechanism; project application is inference, not browser measurement

patterns.name: Scroll advances a short stable scene
patterns.mechanism: Map scroll progress to a small number of explicit presentation states inside a sticky scene. Keep required information available without the timeline and fall back to ordinary document flow for reduced motion and mobile. Authored tutorial mechanism; implementation untested.

sources.evidence: author-published mechanism; project application is inference, not browser measurement
